name: PLATO MPEC Benchmark
description: Evaluates solvers for Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints (MPEC) on 28 medium-sized instances from MacMPEC and MPECLib, using AMPL format. MPEC problems arise in bilevel optimisation, market equilibria, and contact mechanics, and are characterised by complementarity constraints that violate standard constraint qualifications, making them particularly challenging for classical NLP solvers.
typical_sota_score: KNITRO-15.0.1 (25/28 solved, 1.0s geometric mean); filter-MPEC (18/28, 10.4s); LOQO-7.03 (6/28, 22.8s). 500-second time limit.
reputation: Niche but authoritative benchmark for MPEC/bilevel optimisation solvers; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Complementarity constraints violate MFCQ, complicating standard NLP analysis. Problem sources: MacMPEC and GAMS MPECLib on GitHub.
